definition: Demanded something forcefully, not accepting refusal.
exampleSentence: The chief executive insisted that all safety protocols had been upheld.

definition: Admitted that one has committed a crime or done something wrong.
exampleSentence: The suspect confessed that he had manipulated the security logs.
The committee advocated that educational funding should be doubled.

definition: Said or did something to remove doubts or fears.
exampleSentence: The doctor reassured the family that the patient was recovering steadily.

definition: Demanded or specified a requirement, typically as part of a bargain.
exampleSentence: The contract stipulated that delivery had to take place before December.
